sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A note by Isshin in the watch tower. Perhaps Emma knows his current whereabouts.
Dear Emma,
The Ashina Castle Gate has grown loud with the sound of scurrying. The Tengu will see to the rats, worry not.
Isshin

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This item will be on the floor of Isshin's room only before Wolf comes to know of Isshin's whereabouts from Kuro, If Sekiro has already met the Tengu of Ashina in Ashina Castle Gate, or until he has spoken with the Tengu.
